answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism: stake-weighted reputation with costly attestation. Each agent locks a stake and earns trust only when peers it has actually verified vouch for its work — think of reputation as a ridge that must be climbed block by block, while fake identities stay hollow inside, with no history or stake behind them. New agents start in a mesa-like probation zone where their claims are sampled and audited heavily. Collusion gets slashed, so mass-creating cheap identities never pays.
